validators.purpose: Intake binds exact frozen design identity, authority order and working Obligation Register; derivable facts investigated rather than converted into questions; no ambient design/current-file substitution; non-ready or contradictory design fails closed.

Preflight verifies clean worktree, design status/identity, project-native build/test/coverage/static commands, safe test isolation, obligation classification completeness, Contract availability facts and tool/permission availability; unsafe/unclassified/unmeasurable conditions cannot be waived by an Agent.

Every IMPLEMENTATION_FEASIBILITY obligation has a conclusive compatible result and selected binding from the frozen Harness feasibility phase; inconclusive evidence stays in IM-02V; a result that invalidates the frozen design stops the Delivery.

Grilling asked one decision at a time and investigated facts first; every Goal has classification, dependency, Oracle, Test Ladder and completion relation; measurement authority established without architecture decisions.
Every upstream obligation mapped to a Goal, feasibility result, external blocker or operational handoff; no unresolved user decision remains; the Goal Graph is confirmed and frozen by the human.
Feature branch activated from a clean baseline with the baseline commit recorded; no auto-stash, reset, merge or conflicting-branch reuse.

Deterministic selector order: Harness prerequisite, minimum end-to-end Walking Skeleton, then topological Goal/Test Ladder order; Implementer preference cannot choose the next Goal; a missing Contract waits only when no independent Ready Goal remains.

Current behavior fails for the expected reason, or existing-green is challenged by a negative fixture/controlled mutant; a test file that merely exists is insufficient; flaky/skipped/misdirected/non-discriminating tests cannot enter implementation.

The smallest production-code change turns the calibrated RED into GREEN; no formal test/fixture/Harness/coverage/writer-policy changes; diagnostic probes stay ignored and non-authoritative; stubs bound to known Contracts only.

New/modified behavior-bearing branches require 100% coverage plus branch-specific assertions; historical coverage cannot regress; generated/non-behavioral/proven-unreachable exclusions require exact evidence and later Auditor admission.

Refactor improves the current prototype without changing frozen behavior; no speculative abstraction, future feature, generic HA/transaction/retry machinery or unrelated cleanup; NO_REFACTOR_NEEDED is valid.
Rung verification checks current tests, affected regression, writer policy, stub ledger and Action evidence against one Git baseline; a random rerun to obtain GREEN is prohibited.

Both review lenses started fresh from the same Goal candidate and remained isolated until the barrier closed; black-box lens did not inspect the implementation before its initial counterexample result froze; shared raw evidence does not equal shared conclusions.

Aggregation preserved provenance, merged only clear common causes, detected conflicts, routed each Finding; no voting, no severity changes, no test/code edits and no Finding closure by the aggregator.

Resolution stayed strictly within the frozen Goal (test-side: tests/fixtures only; implementation-side: production code only); negative feedback order is failing executable test, deterministic rule, then structured semantic recheck; any requested semantic expansion stops the Delivery.

Only the original Finding lens closes its Finding against the exact treatment and new candidate in a fresh session; Implementer/Aggregator cannot close it; the Finding records its review scope and return Action so recovery cannot confuse the two loops.

All Goal rungs complete, local Findings closed, writer/scope clean, focused/affected regression/coverage green, no unauthorized stubs; commit only explicit approved paths with Goal identity; RED states remain checkpoints, never commits.

Cross-Goal composition, shared state, final Project Context applicability, mapped implementation-verification obligations and full regression pass against the complete branch; Findings return through IM-13; no partial success.
validators.input: branch, goal commits and regression evidence

validators.purpose: Terminal Gate: every in-scope Goal VERIFIED, all Findings disposition-valid, required Harness phases pass against the candidate, no unauthorized stub/debug artifact, process artifacts absent from Git, worktree clean, exact run-manifest/retention disposition valid; an unmeasured tuning value cannot be reported as passed; no push/PR/merge/deploy.

Writer policy compares the Action-start Git baseline with staged, unstaged, renamed, deleted and untracked paths; Test Designer writes formal tests only, Implementer writes production code only; no cross-writer edits.
Package CLI outputs structured JSON, command/argv, exit status, checked identities and bounded stdout/stderr; frozen argv arrays and shell=false; CLI failure is never reinterpreted as success.

prohibited: severity change without the source lens

conformance.preconditions: one ready pure-behavior Goal; clean repository
conformance.expected: one Goal commit; VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION_READY; no publication effect

conformance.scenario: Harness Goal plus core and collaborator Goals with Walking Skeleton and Contract-bound stubs
conformance.expected: serialized production writes, per-Goal commits, stub replacement, whole-scope success

conformance.scenario: baseline already satisfies the Goal; controlled negative fixture/mutant proves discrimination
conformance.expected: Goal completes without unnecessary production change

conformance.scenario: four upstream obligations classified separately and routed to feasibility/verification/tuning
conformance.expected: only dependent Goals wait; candidate completes without false evidence claims

conformance.scenario: a successor proposal outside the declared out-edge set
conformance.expected: rejected; no state advance; fail closed

conformance.scenario: Implementer edits formal tests or Test Designer edits production code
conformance.expected: writer gate fails; no commit; fail closed

conformance.scenario: non-discriminating, skipped, flaky or misdirected tests presented as calibrated
conformance.expected: calibration gate fails; cannot enter implementation

conformance.scenario: missing resource, unresolved route binding or Driver substitution
conformance.expected: admission/recovery fails explicitly; no ambient fallback

conformance.scenario: wait.user-measurement or wait.external-coordination answer is stale or mismatched
conformance.preconditions: correlation identity differs from the pending wait
conformance.expected: no resume; wait persists; no state advance

conformance.scenario: attempt budget exhausted during the Goal Loop
conformance.expected: terminal:INCOMPLETE with current Goal/rung, baseline, attempts, Findings and resume Action; no Gate relaxed

conformance.scenario: a measured feasibility result crosses a frozen design-reopen condition
conformance.expected: current Delivery stops at terminal:DESIGN_REOPEN; new Delivery requires a new design version

conformance.scenario: checkpoint binding identities are re-resolved before recovery
conformance.expected: fail closed into explicit reconciliation/INCOMPLETE; no blind replay
